subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should GitHub Copilot native-search routing require provider-owned account/model capability with managed fallback, and which shared helper—if any—should become supported public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: The provider deliberately supports optimistic forward-compatible models, while this PR infers hosted-search support from names and expands a public SDK subpath; the durable fallback and external API contracts require maintainer intent.

options.title: Capability-aware fallback
options.body: Carry verified Copilot native-search eligibility, retain managed search otherwise, and expose only the approved high-level wrapper.

options.title: Accept inferred eligibility
options.body: Keep regex-based routing and both exports only after exact-head supported and unsupported live proof plus explicit compatibility approval.

options.title: Defer native Copilot search
options.body: Retain managed search until Copilot eligibility can be represented reliably in the provider runtime.

recommendation.title: Capability-aware fallback
recommendation.body: Carry verified Copilot native-search eligibility, retain managed search otherwise, and expose only the approved high-level wrapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current native-search implementation being generalized and have the strongest history across the affected provider and Plugin SDK files.
